## Specification

### Component: Announcement bar

A dismissible strip at the top of a page or app for news, a launch or a maintenance window, with an optional link. Dismissing collapses its height so the page below glides up. A client component.

#### Anatomy
- Wrapper `<div class="ui-announcement-bar-collapse" data-state="open|closed" [data-animate]>` > `.ui-announcement-bar-collapse-inner` (grid row 1fr → 0fr on close).
- Strip `<div class="ui-announcement-bar" role="region" aria-label="Announcement" data-variant="neutral|primary|gradient-subtle" [data-dismissible]>`:
  - `.ui-announcement-bar-content`: optional `.ui-announcement-bar-icon` (or `AnnouncementBarBadge` → `span.ui-announcement-bar-badge`), `p.ui-announcement-bar-message`, optional action.
  - `button.ui-announcement-bar-close` (`aria-label="Dismiss announcement"`, × icon 16px).
- `AnnouncementBarLink` → `a.ui-announcement-bar-link` > `.ui-announcement-bar-link-label` + arrow icon `.ui-announcement-bar-link-arrow` (`asChild` keeps that structure inside a Next.js `Link`).

#### Props
- `variant`: `neutral` (default) · `primary` · `gradient-subtle`.
- `open` / `defaultOpen` (true) / `onOpenChange`; `dismissible` (true); `dismissLabel`.
- `storageKey`: remember dismissal in `localStorage` (value `"dismissed"`). Change the key for a new announcement.
- `icon` (ReactNode: an `Icon` or a badge), `action` (ReactNode: usually `AnnouncementBarLink`), `aria-label` (landmark name, default "Announcement").
- `AnnouncementBarLink`: anchor props, `asChild`, `arrow` (true).

#### Behaviour
- The × sets open to false (writing the storage key first). `usePresence` keeps the bar mounted until the collapse animation ends, then unmounts.
- SSR: the server always renders the bar. After hydration, if the key is stored, the bar unmounts at once with no animation. Other tabs that dismiss it close it here too (`storage` event).
- Re-opening after the first render animates open (`data-animate`); the first render never animates.
- Storage errors (blocked storage) are swallowed: the bar still closes for this view.

#### Visual rules
- Strip: min-height 40px, padding 8px 16px (48px each side when dismissible so centred text never runs under the ×), 13px text, centred content (max-width 72rem) with 10px gaps; bottom border.
- neutral: `--ui-surface-muted`, `--ui-foreground`, `--ui-border`. primary: `--ui-primary` / `--ui-primary-foreground`, no border, muted parts at 78% foreground. gradient-subtle: 90° wash of `--ui-series-1` 12% → `--ui-series-2` 10% → `--ui-series-4` 10% over `--ui-surface`, border tinted with series-1.
- Badge: 20px pill, 12px/500, primary fill (on primary: foreground 18% wash).
- Link: inherits colour, 500, underline at 40% (100% on hover), offset 3px; arrow 14px.
- ×: 28px square, radius md, muted colour, hover 10% foreground wash, `::before` grows the hit area to 44px.
- ≤ 640px: content starts at the inline start instead of centring.

#### Motion
- Dismiss: wrapper `grid-template-rows 1fr → 0fr` + opacity over 280ms `--ui-ease-in-out`; the strip lifts 4px with a 2px blur over `--ui-duration-exit`.
- Re-open: rows 0fr → 1fr on `--ui-spring-smooth`.
- Link arrow nudges 2px on hover (snappy spring); × presses to .94.
- Reduced motion: collapse is instant; no lift.

#### Accessibility
- `role="region"` with an `aria-label` makes it a findable landmark; give each bar on a page its own label.
- × is a real button with an accessible name; focus ring 3px (on primary: a 2px primary-foreground ring).
- No `role="alert"`: an announcement is page content, not an interruption.

#### Acceptance checks
- Clicking × collapses the bar to height 0 and removes it; content below moves up.
- With `storageKey`, reload after dismissing: the bar is gone after hydration; clearing the key brings it back.
- Controlled: `open={false}` hides it; `onOpenChange(false)` fires on ×.
- Three variants render with ≥ 4.5:1 text contrast in light and dark.

### `ui/components/announcement-bar/announcement-bar.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import {
  cloneElement,
  forwardRef,
  isValidElement,
  useEffect,
  useState,
  type AnchorHTMLAttributes,
  type HTMLAttributes,
  type ReactNode,
} from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { Slot } from '../../lib/slot';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { usePresence } from '../../hooks/use-presence';
import { Icon } from '../../icons/icon';

export type AnnouncementBarVariant = 'neutral' | 'primary' | 'gradient-subtle';

export interface AnnouncementBarProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  /** Surface: `neutral` (muted well), `primary` (brand fill) or `gradient-subtle` (soft two-tone wash). Default `neutral`. */
  variant?: AnnouncementBarVariant;
  /** Controlled visibility. */
  open?: boolean;
  /** Initial visibility when uncontrolled. Default true. */
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
  /** Called when visibility changes (the × button sets it to false). */
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
  /** Show the × button. Default true. */
  dismissible?: boolean;
  /** Accessible name of the × button. Default `Dismiss announcement`. */
  dismissLabel?: string;
  /**
   * Remember the dismissal in localStorage under this key. Change the key for a
   * new announcement. Read after hydration, so the server always renders the bar.
   */
  storageKey?: string;
  /** Leading icon, or a short pill such as "New" (see `AnnouncementBarBadge`). */
  icon?: ReactNode;
  /** A link or button after the message (see `AnnouncementBarLink`). */
  action?: ReactNode;
  /** Name of the region landmark. Default `Announcement`. */
  'aria-label'?: string;
}

const readDismissed = (key: string) => {
  try {
    return window.localStorage.getItem(key) === 'dismissed';
  } catch {
    return false; // storage blocked (private mode, sandboxed iframe)
  }
};

const writeDismissed = (key: string) => {
  try {
    window.localStorage.setItem(key, 'dismissed');
  } catch {
    /* storage blocked: the bar still closes for this page view */
  }
};

/**
 * AnnouncementBar — a dismissible strip at the top of a page or app for news,
 * a launch or a maintenance window. Dismissing collapses its height so the
 * page below glides up, then unmounts it. With `storageKey` the dismissal is
 * remembered across visits (SSR-safe: read after hydration).
 */
export const AnnouncementBar = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, AnnouncementBarProps>(function AnnouncementBar(
  {
    variant = 'neutral',
    open: openProp,
    defaultOpen = true,
    onOpenChange,
    dismissible = true,
    dismissLabel = 'Dismiss announcement',
    storageKey,
    icon,
    action,
    className,
    children,
    'aria-label': ariaLabel = 'Announcement',
    ...props
  },
  ref,
) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useControllableState({ value: openProp, defaultValue: defaultOpen, onChange: onOpenChange });
  // Hidden from storage on load: unmount at once, no exit animation
  const [restored, setRestored] = useState(false);
  // Opening after the first render animates; the initial render never does.
  // Derived during render, so the attribute lands in the same commit as the open state.
  const [prevOpen, setPrevOpen] = useState(open);
  const [animateOpen, setAnimateOpen] = useState(false);
  if (open !== prevOpen) {
    setPrevOpen(open);
    setAnimateOpen(open);
    if (open) setRestored(false);
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!storageKey) return;
    if (readDismissed(storageKey)) {
      setRestored(true);
      setOpen(false);
    }
    const onStorage = (e: StorageEvent) => {
      if (e.key === storageKey && e.newValue === 'dismissed') setOpen(false);
    };
    window.addEventListener('storage', onStorage);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('storage', onStorage);
  }, [storageKey, setOpen]);

  const { mounted, state, ref: presenceRef } = usePresence<HTMLDivElement>(open);
  if (!mounted || (!open && restored)) return null;

  const dismiss = () => {
    if (storageKey) writeDismissed(storageKey);
    setOpen(false);
  };

  return (
    // The wrapper animates its height to zero so the page below glides up instead of jumping
    <div
      ref={presenceRef}
      className="ui-announcement-bar-collapse"
      data-state={state}
      data-animate={animateOpen ? '' : undefined}
    >
      <div className="ui-announcement-bar-collapse-inner">
        <div
          ref={ref}
          role="region"
          aria-label={ariaLabel}
          data-variant={variant}
          data-dismissible={dismissible ? '' : undefined}
          className={cn('ui-announcement-bar', className)}
          {...props}
        >
          <div className="ui-announcement-bar-content">
            {icon != null && icon !== false && <span className="ui-announcement-bar-icon">{icon}</span>}
            <p className="ui-announcement-bar-message">{children}</p>
            {action}
          </div>
          {dismissible && (
            <button type="button" className="ui-announcement-bar-close" aria-label={dismissLabel} onClick={dismiss}>
              <Icon name="x" size={16} />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
});

export interface AnnouncementBarLinkProps extends AnchorHTMLAttributes<HTMLAnchorElement> {
  /** Render the child (e.g. a Next.js `<Link>` or a `<button>`) with the link styles. */
  asChild?: boolean;
  /** Show the trailing arrow. Default true. */
  arrow?: boolean;
}

/** The call to action inside the bar: underlined, with an arrow that nudges on hover. */
export const AnnouncementBarLink = forwardRef<HTMLAnchorElement, AnnouncementBarLinkProps>(function AnnouncementBarLink(
  { asChild = false, arrow = true, className, children, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const inner = (label: ReactNode) => (
    <>
      <span className="ui-announcement-bar-link-label">{label}</span>
      {arrow && <Icon name="arrow-right" size={14} className="ui-announcement-bar-link-arrow" />}
    </>
  );
  if (asChild) {
    // Keep the label + arrow structure inside the consumer's element
    const child = isValidElement<{ children?: ReactNode }>(children)
      ? cloneElement(children, undefined, inner(children.props.children))
      : children;
    return (
      <Slot ref={ref} className={cn('ui-announcement-bar-link', className)} {...(props as HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>)}>
        {child}
      </Slot>
    );
  }
  return (
    <a ref={ref} className={cn('ui-announcement-bar-link', className)} {...props}>
      {inner(children)}
    </a>
  );
});

/** A short pill before the message ("New", "Beta"). */
export const AnnouncementBarBadge = forwardRef<HTMLSpanElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>>(function AnnouncementBarBadge(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <span ref={ref} className={cn('ui-announcement-bar-badge', className)} {...props} />;
});
```

### `ui/hooks/use-controllable-state.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';

/**
 * State that can be controlled (`value` + `onChange`) or uncontrolled
 * (`defaultValue`). Every stateful component uses this so the two modes
 * behave identically.
 */
export function useControllableState<T>({
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onChange,
}: {
  value?: T;
  defaultValue: T;
  onChange?: (value: T) => void;
}): [T, (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void] {
  const [internal, setInternal] = useState<T>(defaultValue);
  const controlled = value !== undefined;
  const current = controlled ? (value as T) : internal;
  const currentRef = useRef(current);
  currentRef.current = current;
  const onChangeRef = useRef(onChange);
  onChangeRef.current = onChange;

  const setValue = useCallback(
    (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => {
      const resolved = typeof next === 'function' ? (next as (prev: T) => T)(currentRef.current) : next;
      if (Object.is(resolved, currentRef.current)) return;
      currentRef.current = resolved;
      if (!controlled) setInternal(resolved);
      onChangeRef.current?.(resolved);
    },
    [controlled],
  );

  return [current, setValue];
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-presence.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { animationsFinished } from '../lib/dom';
import { useIsomorphicLayoutEffect } from './use-isomorphic-layout-effect';

/**
 * Keeps an element mounted until its exit animation has finished.
 *   const { mounted, state, ref } = usePresence(open);
 *   {mounted && <div ref={ref} data-state={state} />}
 * CSS animates on [data-state="open" | "closed"]; nothing else is needed.
 */
export function usePresence<T extends Element = HTMLElement>(present: boolean) {
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(present);
  const ref = useRef<T | null>(null);

  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (present) {
      setMounted(true);
      return;
    }
    let cancelled = false;
    animationsFinished(ref.current).then(() => {
      if (!cancelled) setMounted(false);
    });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [present]);

  return {
    mounted: present || mounted,
    state: (present ? 'open' : 'closed') as 'open' | 'closed',
    ref,
  };
}
```

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/compose-refs.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, type Ref, type RefCallback } from 'react';

type PossibleRef<T> = Ref<T> | undefined;

function setRef<T>(ref: PossibleRef<T>, value: T | null) {
  if (typeof ref === 'function') ref(value);
  else if (ref) (ref as { current: T | null }).current = value;
}

/** Merge several refs into one callback ref. */
export function composeRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  return (node) => {
    for (const ref of refs) setRef(ref, node);
  };
}

/** Memoised composeRefs for use inside components. */
export function useComposedRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs);
}
```

### `ui/lib/dom.ts`

```ts
/** True when rendering on the server (no DOM). */
export const isServer = typeof window === 'undefined';

/** Resolve once every animation on `el` (and its subtree) has finished. */
export function animationsFinished(el: Element | null, subtree = true): Promise<void> {
  if (!el || typeof el.getAnimations !== 'function') return Promise.resolve();
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    // Wait a frame so animations triggered by the state change have started.
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const anims = el.getAnimations({ subtree });
      if (!anims.length) return resolve();
      Promise.allSettled(anims.map((a) => a.finished)).then(() => resolve());
    });
  });
}

export function prefersReducedMotion(): boolean {
  return !isServer && window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches === true;
}
```

### `ui/lib/slot.tsx`

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import {
  Children,
  cloneElement,
  forwardRef,
  isValidElement,
  type HTMLAttributes,
  type ReactElement,
  type ReactNode,
  type Ref,
} from 'react';
import { cn } from './cn';
import { composeRefs } from './compose-refs';

/**
 * Slot — renders its single child instead of its own element, merging props.
 * Powers `asChild`: <Button asChild><a href="/">Home</a></Button>.
 * Event handlers are chained (child first), className is joined, style merged.
 */
export interface SlotProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> {
  children?: ReactNode;
}

type AnyProps = Record<string, unknown>;

const LAZY = Symbol.for('react.lazy');

/**
 * In React Server Components, children passed into a client component can arrive
 * as lazy references. Unwrap them with React.use (React 19) before cloning.
 */
function resolveLazy(node: ReactNode): ReactNode {
  const maybe = node as { $$typeof?: symbol; _payload?: unknown } | null;
  const use = (React as unknown as { use?: (p: unknown) => ReactNode }).use;
  if (maybe && typeof maybe === 'object' && maybe.$$typeof === LAZY && typeof use === 'function') {
    return use(maybe._payload);
  }
  return node;
}

function mergeProps(slotProps: AnyProps, childProps: AnyProps): AnyProps {
  const merged: AnyProps = { ...slotProps, ...childProps };
  for (const key of Object.keys(slotProps)) {
    const slotValue = slotProps[key];
    const childValue = childProps[key];
    if (/^on[A-Z]/.test(key) && typeof slotValue === 'function' && typeof childValue === 'function') {
      merged[key] = (...args: unknown[]) => {
        (childValue as (...a: unknown[]) => void)(...args);
        (slotValue as (...a: unknown[]) => void)(...args);
      };
    } else if (key === 'className') {
      merged[key] = cn(slotValue as string, childValue as string);
    } else if (key === 'style') {
      merged[key] = { ...(slotValue as object), ...(childValue as object) };
    }
  }
  return merged;
}

export const Slot = forwardRef<HTMLElement, SlotProps>(function Slot({ children, ...props }, ref) {
  const child = resolveLazy(Children.only(resolveLazy(children) as ReactElement));
  if (!isValidElement(child)) return null;
  const element = child as ReactElement<AnyProps & { ref?: Ref<HTMLElement> }>;
  // React 19 exposes ref as a prop; React 18 keeps it on the element.
  const childRef = (element.props.ref ?? (element as unknown as { ref?: Ref<HTMLElement> }).ref) as Ref<HTMLElement> | undefined;
  return cloneElement(element, {
    ...mergeProps(props as AnyProps, element.props),
    ref: ref ? composeRefs(ref, childRef) : childRef,
  });
});
```

### `ui/styles/components/announcement-bar.css`

```css
/* Announcement bar ---------------------------------------------------------
   <div class="ui-announcement-bar-collapse" data-state="open|closed" [data-animate]>
     <div class="ui-announcement-bar-collapse-inner">
       <div class="ui-announcement-bar" role="region" aria-label="Announcement"
            data-variant="neutral|primary|gradient-subtle" [data-dismissible]>
         .ui-announcement-bar-content > [.ui-announcement-bar-icon | .ui-announcement-bar-badge]
                                        p.ui-announcement-bar-message
                                        a.ui-announcement-bar-link (> -link-label + -link-arrow)
         button.ui-announcement-bar-close
   Dismiss: the wrapper's grid row animates 1fr to 0fr while the strip fades and
   lifts, so the page below glides up. Re-opening (after first render) reverses it.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@keyframes ui-announcement-bar-collapse {
  from { grid-template-rows: 1fr; opacity: 1; }
  to { grid-template-rows: 0fr; opacity: 0; }
}
@keyframes ui-announcement-bar-expand {
  from { grid-template-rows: 0fr; opacity: 0; }
  to { grid-template-rows: 1fr; opacity: 1; }
}
@keyframes ui-announcement-bar-lift {
  to { transform: translateY(-4px); filter: blur(var(--ui-blur-subtle)); }
}

@layer components {
  .ui-announcement-bar-collapse { display: grid; grid-template-rows: 1fr; }
  .ui-announcement-bar-collapse-inner { min-height: 0; }
  .ui-announcement-bar-collapse[data-state="closed"] {
    animation: ui-announcement-bar-collapse 280ms var(--ui-ease-in-out) both;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .ui-announcement-bar-collapse[data-state="closed"] .ui-announcement-bar-collapse-inner { overflow: hidden; }
  .ui-announcement-bar-collapse[data-state="closed"] .ui-announcement-bar {
    animation: ui-announcement-bar-lift var(--ui-duration-exit) var(--ui-ease-in) both;
  }
  .ui-announcement-bar-collapse[data-animate][data-state="open"] {
    animation: ui-announcement-bar-expand var(--ui-spring-smooth-duration) var(--ui-spring-smooth) both;
  }
  .ui-announcement-bar-collapse[data-animate][data-state="open"] .ui-announcement-bar-collapse-inner { overflow: hidden; }

  /* The strip */
  .ui-announcement-bar {
    --ui-ab-bg: var(--ui-surface-muted);
    --ui-ab-fg: var(--ui-foreground);
    --ui-ab-muted: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    --ui-ab-border: var(--ui-border);
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    min-height: 2.5rem;
    padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ui-ab-border);
    background: var(--ui-ab-bg);
    color: var(--ui-ab-fg);
    font-size: var(--text-sm);
    line-height: var(--text-sm--line-height);
  }
  /* Room for the × so centred text never runs under it */
  .ui-announcement-bar[data-dismissible] { padding-inline: 3rem; }

  .ui-announcement-bar[data-variant="primary"] {
    --ui-ab-bg: var(--ui-primary);
    --ui-ab-fg: var(--ui-primary-foreground);
    --ui-ab-muted: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-primary-foreground) 78%, var(--ui-primary));
    --ui-ab-border: transparent;
  }
  /* A soft two-tone wash from the first two data series, over the page surface */
  .ui-announcement-bar[data-variant="gradient-subtle"] {
    --ui-ab-border: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-series-1) 18%, var(--ui-border));
    background:
      linear-gradient(
        90deg,
        color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-series-1) 12%, var(--ui-surface)),
        color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-series-2) 10%, var(--ui-surface)) 55%,
        color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-series-4) 10%, var(--ui-surface))
      );
  }

  .ui-announcement-bar-content {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    column-gap: 0.625rem;
    row-gap: 0.25rem;
    min-width: 0;
    max-width: 72rem;
    text-align: center;
  }
  .ui-announcement-bar-icon { display: inline-grid; flex-shrink: 0; place-items: center; color: var(--ui-ab-muted); }
  .ui-announcement-bar-icon > svg { display: block; width: 1rem; height: 1rem; }
  .ui-announcement-bar-message { margin: 0; min-width: 0; }
  .ui-announcement-bar-message strong { font-weight: 600; }

  .ui-announcement-bar-badge {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    height: 1.25rem;
    padding-inline: 0.5rem;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background-color: var(--ui-primary);
    color: var(--ui-primary-foreground);
    font-size: var(--text-xs);
    line-height: 1;
    font-weight: 500;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .ui-announcement-bar[data-variant="primary"] .ui-announcement-bar-badge {
    background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-primary-foreground) 18%, transparent);
    color: var(--ui-primary-foreground);
  }

  /* Call to action */
  .ui-announcement-bar-link {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.25rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    color: inherit;
    font-weight: 500;
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-decoration-color: color-mix(in oklch, currentColor 40%, transparent);
    text-decoration-thickness: 1px;
    text-underline-offset: 3px;
    white-space: nowrap;
    cursor: pointer;
    outline: none;
    transition:
      text-decoration-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      box-shadow var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  .ui-announcement-bar-link-arrow {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    transition: transform var(--ui-spring-snappy-duration) var(--ui-spring-snappy);
  }
  [dir="rtl"] .ui-announcement-bar-link-arrow { scale: -1 1; }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-announcement-bar-link:hover { text-decoration-color: currentColor; }
    /* In RTL the arrow's `scale: -1 1` flips this nudge too, so it still points forward */
    .ui-announcement-bar-link:hover .ui-announcement-bar-link-arrow { transform: translateX(2px); }
  }
  .ui-announcement-bar-link:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent); }

  /* Dismiss */
  .ui-announcement-bar-close {
    position: absolute;
    inset-inline-end: 0.5rem;
    top: 50%;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    width: 1.75rem;
    height: 1.75rem;
    margin-top: -0.875rem;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--ui-ab-muted);
    cursor: pointer;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    outline: none;
    transition:
      background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      box-shadow var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      transform var(--ui-spring-snappy-duration) var(--ui-spring-snappy);
  }
  /* 44px touch target without growing the strip */
  .ui-announcement-bar-close::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -0.5rem; }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-announcement-bar-close:hover { background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ab-fg) 10%, transparent); color: var(--ui-ab-fg); }
  }
  .ui-announcement-bar-close:active { transform: scale(0.94); }
  .ui-announcement-bar-close:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent); }
  .ui-announcement-bar[data-variant="primary"] .ui-announcement-bar-close:focus-visible,
  .ui-announcement-bar[data-variant="primary"] .ui-announcement-bar-link:focus-visible {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-primary-foreground) 70%, transparent);
  }

  /* Phones: text starts at the edge, so a two-line message reads naturally */
  @media (max-width: 40rem) {
    .ui-announcement-bar { justify-content: flex-start; }
    .ui-announcement-bar[data-dismissible] { padding-inline: 1rem 3rem; }
    .ui-announcement-bar-content { justify-content: flex-start; text-align: start; }
  }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .ui-announcement-bar-collapse[data-state="closed"] .ui-announcement-bar { animation: none; }
  }
}
```

## Usage

**Variants** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/announcement-bar/variants.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
import { AnnouncementBar, AnnouncementBarBadge, AnnouncementBarLink } from '@/ui/components/announcement-bar';
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons/icon';

export default function AnnouncementBarVariants() {
  return (
    <div className="grid w-full gap-3">
      <AnnouncementBar
        aria-label="Maintenance notice"
        icon={<Icon name="clock" />}
        action={<AnnouncementBarLink href="#status">Status page</AnnouncementBarLink>}
      >
        Scheduled maintenance on Sunday 30 November, 02:00–03:00 UTC.
      </AnnouncementBar>
      <AnnouncementBar
        variant="primary"
        aria-label="Product launch"
        icon={<AnnouncementBarBadge>New</AnnouncementBarBadge>}
        action={<AnnouncementBarLink href="#changelog">Read the changelog</AnnouncementBarLink>}
      >
        Usage-based billing is live for every workspace.
      </AnnouncementBar>
      <AnnouncementBar
        variant="gradient-subtle"
        aria-label="Event"
        icon={<Icon name="sparkles" />}
        action={<AnnouncementBarLink href="#register">Save your seat</AnnouncementBarLink>}
      >
        <strong>Northwind Live</strong> — 4 December, online and free.
      </AnnouncementBar>
    </div>
  );
}
```
